label: Stationed green laser weapons in the corners of America
description: Something shot above the United States, an urgent need for the Golden Dome, and stationed electric green laser weapons seen positioned in corners of the country for air defence. Given 15 June 2025, three weeks after the Golden Dome programme was announced publicly.

label: Watch Omaha
description: Given alongside the Pearl Harbor material on 15 June 2025: he reports being told that Pearl Harbor caught America off guard because nobody saw it coming, and then simply to watch Omaha. No event is attached to the city. Omaha houses US Strategic Command at Offutt Air Force Base.

label: The Vatican splits, and a demonic spirit influences the man
description: The Vatican seen splitting with a whitening, and a demonic spirit trying to come on a man there to influence him badly. He states outright that he does not know the year and that if it happens it does not happen in 2025.

label: A major scandal breaking at a California megachurch
description: Seen 15 June 2025, following the shot heard around the world: an exposing at a megachurch in California, with a major scandal about to break loose and an instruction to watch California. Some will say they knew and others will be shocked.

label: Trump and Kim Jong-un like Jonathan and David
description: That the American and North Korean leaders would become like Jonathan and David in the days ahead, given while North Korea is quiet and its plans unknown. Sits against his own claim six weeks earlier that North Korea is the hitman who carries out a Pearl Harbor attack on America at China's direction.
